mapper.sql: SELECT request_id, request_no, title, status, priority, expect_date, purpose, total_amount, requester_id, requester_name, dept_id, dept_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, plan_id, plan_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_purchase_request
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_purchase_request ( request_no, title, status, priority, expect_date, purpose, total_amount, requester_id, requester_name, dept_id, dept_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, plan_id, plan_no, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{requestNo}, #{title}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{expectDate}, #{purpose}, #{totalAmount}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterName}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{planId}, #{planNo}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_purchase_request SET del_flag = '2' WHERE request_id IN #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, request_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, qty, estimated_price, estimated_amount, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_purchase_request_detail WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_purchase_request_detail SET del_flag = '2' WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
